title: 2024 Topps Series 2 - Stars of MLB #SMLB-39 Joey Votto Reds
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a sports trading card featuring Joey Votto from the Cincinnati Reds in the 2024 Topps Series 2 set. It is part of the Stars of MLB insert set and is card number SMLB-39. Manufactured by Topps, this trading card is a collectible item for fans of baseball and sports trading cards.
